Searched: Stanford profile (captured) has only a 'Stanford Advisees' dissertation-role block, no lab/personal member page found; GSE faculty page links no lab.

'ADVISING' section (Postdoc / PhD / Other Student Researchers) undated and not labelled current (page has 2026 news); section other under the strict rule. PhD students all co-advised. Nidhi Parthasarathy is at Lynbrook High School; Oliver Huang at University of Toronto.

Profile captured; personal website link gsb-faculty.stanford.edu/harikesh-nair redirects (301) to the GSB home page; no lab/member page found. Heading 'Ph.D. Students' under 'Students'; no 'current' wording and no per-name dates, only page footer 'Updated September 2026' (so section other under the strict rule; a reviewer may judge it current). Anushka Murthy co-advised with Ramesh Johari (Stanford). Former student Yuan Shi only in a news item, not listed.
hennessy.stanford.edu captured: president-emeritus/Knight-Hennessy site with no student or member list.

Not listed: visiting professors Taesoo Kwon, Iryna Barba, research affiliate Atul Salvekar (listed once as alumnus), former visiting professors. Emails on the page were not copied.

Profile (captured) has no advisee block or links; niebles.net (captured) lists no students; shared SVL lab people page not tied to him (search found only a pre-2021 group page naming him as scientist).
Profile captured (advisee roles only, no group page link); web search found no personal or group member page.
Profile captured (advisee roles only); Platform Lab link not a member list of his; search found only genealogy sites (not own page).

Page is the Systems Optimization Laboratory (SOL, MS&E) students/alumni/visitors page (lab shared by Gill, Murray, Saunders, Wright); not Saunders-specific, so names are SOL students, not necessarily advised by Saunders. Alumni year headings (e.g. (2019) before a name) were attached to the names that follow them. Saunders personal page (saunders.people.stanford.edu) lists no students. Dates are PhD years. People page lists only Cherry Lab staff (biocurators, data wranglers, software developers; marked no longer updated as of December 2025) and no students or postdocs at all; nothing to list. The lab is a genomic-database group (SGD, ENCODE).

Personal page web.stanford.edu/~mohamwad/ (captured, sha256 1f9cc9a90f89978ee531c6393fb41b3fc3cfdef0562a33e15f36aa903fbd23da) has papers, teaching and CV only, no students list; GSB PhD students appear only as coauthors. profiles.stanford.edu has no member list. No lab page found among candidates.
Lab page gevaertlab.stanford.edu/people refused by the capture tool (robots disallows or unreadable); candidate profiles.stanford.edu page is a profile with no member list. Not captured.
Candidate robotics.stanford.edu/~shoham returned 301/404; found his personal site yoavshoham.net via search (he is emeritus). Page is an undated list of past PhD students; no current students.

Alumni page of the Wireless Systems Lab; the alumni page carries the names; the current-members page wsl.stanford.edu/people was captured too (sha d485a0c9) and lists only Goldsmith (Emerita) plus an Alumni link ; the current-members page wsl.stanford.edu/people was captured 2026-11-11 (sha256 d485a0c97d60d89e519743d1709ee9d510200a9a7fcbf3d2afde9fcf05e0ebcd) and lists only Goldsmith (Emerita) and a link to Alumni, no current students, so nothing current is missing. Former PhD students 22 (14 dated), postdocs 20, visitors 38, MS 6. Names were taken verbatim in the page order; Yuxin Chen and Yao Xie are listed by the page under former PhD students.

Lab homepage People block, Advisees list; no section is labelled Current, but it is the live lab page (papers marked To appear 2026) and is treated as current. Rotation students (Autumn 2024) and Ihyun Nam (Rotating PhD Student) excluded as rotation. The page also shows a lorem-ipsum About text.

The People page has PhDs / Postdocs / Faculty / Recent Alumni headings but no literal word Current or date; PhDs and Postdocs sections are treated as the current group. Alumni roles are not stated on the page, so role other. Chris Re himself (listed under Faculty) is not included.

Lab People page (Structures as Sensors Lab). Titles 'PhD Student' read as current; 'Ph.D. Alumni' and employer lines as alumni; alumni roles other than Dong not stated on page. No years on page.

Students section with Current/Former headings. 'Master's and undergraduate' and 'Master's, undergraduate, and HS' groups are mixed: role masters is a coarse label; HS students may be among the former group (not distinguishable). Some doctoral names are 'with' other advisers.

Homepage sections 'Ph.D. students' (current, page carries 2026 items), empty 'Postdocs' (HTML-commented), 'Ph.D. alumni', 'Postdoc alumni'. Homepage http://hci.stanford.edu/msb/ 301s to https.
